source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to attack the next LeanFrontier target. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT inspected live upstream main, the current contribution-directions document, open pull requests, and the accepted Markov/Farey corpus. It found the roadmap lagging accepted work: the logistic conjugacy, oriented Markov tree, Stern-Brocot bridge, three-branch coverage, and cyclic symmetry were already on main. It therefore selected the next structural gap in that line: prove that the canonical Stern-Brocot path embedding is injective at the level of full labelled Markov states, not merely erased move words. The proof uses the accepted orientation invariant: a child has strictly larger coordinate mass than its parent, while the distinguished back move descends. This forces the back edge from the state itself, lets a child state reconstruct its parent, and supports induction proving distinct Stern-Brocot paths cannot merge. The final theorem equates equality of Stern-Brocot pairs with equality of the attached full Markov triples. The development explicitly does not claim that a maximum-coordinate Markov number determines the triple, so it does not cross the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness boundary. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and API and authored the Lean statements and proofs; the human did not materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
